_help: Blank template of a show. Never edited in place: Claude Code copies this folder to concept/<id>/ during the first run (CLAUDE.md, "First run"), then replaces EVERY <...> with the owner's answers. A field that still holds a <...> makes the studio refuse the concept (node --no-warnings core/concept.mjs check <id> lists them). Fields whose name starts with _ are notes, never read by the code.
id: <your concept id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 3 to 31 characters, the same as the folder name>
name: <your show's name, in the videos' language>
name_fr: <your show's name as shown to the owner on the vitrine>
language: <choose the language of the videos: en is the only one the chain supports today (Kokoro en-us, English captions and trend filter)>
hero: <your hero's id: lowercase, e.g. the first name without accents>
hero_pronouns: <choose the hero's pronouns: she, he or they>
hero_lock: <describe your hero in one sentence that starts with the first name: adult age, build, hair, the outfit that never changes, shoes; 20 to 300 characters; never the words text, letters or logo>
palette: <describe your colour scheme in a few words, e.g. colour scheme of ... with ... light and ... shadows>
style: <describe your drawing style: medium, line, faces, colours, background detail, lighting, then always: no text, no letters, no words, no writing, no signs, no watermark>

voice.id: <choose a Kokoro voice id installed on this PC, e.g. af_heart, am_puck, bf_emma, bm_george>
voice.label_fr: <describe the narrator voice for the owner, in French>

image._note: paint_around true = the hero is pasted from the pose sheets (cast/<hero>/*.png) and only the place is painted around, then the whole still is blended at blend_denoise: the hero stays identical from still to still. false = img2img from the sheet at ref_denoise.

format.hook_prefix: <write the words every title starts with, e.g. Imagine, or delete the quotes and write null for a free opening>
format.person: <choose who the narration speaks to: second person (you), first person (I), or third person>
format.twist: <describe where the twist comes, e.g. second-to-last scene>
format._note: scenes / words / seconds: [min, max]; 60 s at most. title_ends_with: a character every title ends with (e.g. "?") or null. last_scene_question: true when the last scene asks the viewer a question.

_on_screen_note: Optional on-screen format of script packages (onScreen block), checked by core/guardrails/playbook.ts. null = only the show-independent rules (no real platform prompt wording, onScreen present once captioned). Otherwise an object: {"lanes": {"<lane id>": {"opener": "<regex the second-1 caption matches>", "chip": "<regex a chip by 1.0 s matches, or null>", "exclusive": true, "hint": "<one sentence for the writer>"}}, "closer": "<caption the close beat shows, or null>", "closer_variant_day": null, "second1_required": true}. closer_variant_day: 0 (Sunday) to 6, the weekday on which any closer is accepted.

framing.closeup: close-up portrait cropped at the chest, head and shoulders filling the frame, the main object of the scene beside the hero, no legs, no feet visible
framing.waist: medium shot cropped at the waist, the hero large in frame, the place clearly visible behind the hero, legs and feet out of frame

prompt.hands: hands relaxed or holding the object of the scene naturally, five fingers, no raised or waving hands
prompt.always: <write one clause the image model must always respect for the hero (e.g. the colour of the coat), or delete the quotes and write null>
prompt.place_style: <describe the style of the PLACES only: the style above without any word about a character, face, eyes or mouth, then: no text, no letters, no words, no signs, no watermark>
prompt.place_member_style: {name} painted in the same style as the place

youtube: <choose a YouTube hashtag for your show, e.g. #Storytime>

yt_tags: <list a YouTube keyword for your show>
